response.justification: Bogdan Szabo has extensive experience in software engineering with a strong focus on full-stack development, cloud technologies, and AI-agent infrastructure, meeting the 15-year requirement. However, his resume lacks explicit AI or ML specialization, entrepreneurial experience, or demonstrated AI product development, which are key preferences. His technical breadth and leadership in open-source and startup-like ventures are notable but do not fully align with the AI strategy focus.
strengths: 15+ years of hands-on software engineering experience across diverse stacks (Node.js, TypeScript, Dlang, Swift, etc.)
Experience with cloud technologies and distributed systems, including Kubernetes and AWS CDK
Proven leadership in open-source projects (GISCollective) and developer tooling, showing technical innovation
concerns: No clear evidence of AI/ML expertise or AI-powered product development in resume or projects
Lacks entrepreneurial or startup experience within larger organizations, which is a preferred qualification
Limited mention of strategic AI or cloud platform strategy work; most roles focus on implementation rather than high-level differentiation
